Message:
[SCSI] qla4xxx: Fix getting BIDI CHAP for boot targets

If a boot target has a BIDI CHAP enabled, then read the user/secret from
CHAP table. Do not assume BIDI chap at peer CHAP index + 1

JIRA Key: UPSISCSI-156
